name: context-menu
title: Context Menu
description: Right-click actions on a file, row, or canvas.

motionProfile.reason: Context Menu owns one anchored popup presence per open branch at the invocation point, its measured shell, scoped row and popup paint, indicator marks and plain row/label text while Base UI keeps the pointer origin, placement, roving focus and unmount.

popup.anchored/one-shot.reason: Each mounted popup shell, including every submenu branch, owns one opacity and anchor-side approach envelope on its own visual layer at the invocation point; Base UI keeps mounting, placement and focus.

exit.fade/one-shot.reason: A closing branch fades on its own opacity channel without moving the invocation point while Base UI retains its actual exit-completion and unmount protocol.

geometry.resize/measured.reason: The open popup shell owns one clamped measured width and height revision over its natural menu content inside the positioned available space.

state.color/css-transition.reason: Item rows own their merged pointer/checked/disabled/destructive surface and foreground paint, the popup shell owns its own surface, and Label, Shortcut and Separator own theirs; focus or an unprovable caller palette settles that region immediately.

state.morph/one-shot.reason: A checkbox or radio mark owns its local opacity and scale indicator revision on its own kept-mounted host, with state and focus already final.

text.change/changed-runs.reason: A plain supplied item, group-label or shortcut string replaces only its changed graphemes; rich item and label content keeps its native identity and is composed.
